title: Undo import removes members who already joined the member app or were measured at the desk
what: When the owner undoes a past import, a member counts as 'used' (and is kept) only after a check-in, a desk payment, extra days, an edit or a PT session. A member who has since linked the MettleUp member app, had weight and body fat measured, got a door-machine number, or was sent a workout or diet plan is still removed. Their app link, measurements and machine number are left pointing at a member who no longer exists, and the screen says 'Nothing you added yourself is removed.'
expected: Undo keeps any imported member who has used the member app, been measured, been given a door number or been sent a plan, and the confirm line counts them among the members that stay.
who: owners who undo an import some days after it
how_often: each undo after members started using the app
fix_line: Count app links, measurements, door numbers and sent plans as 'used' before removing a member

title: An owner's help questions and the MettleUp team's replies show only on the computer they were asked from
what: 'Your questions' on Help and feedback, with late AI answers and the team's replies, is kept only in that browser. An owner who asks from the desk computer and later opens the panel on a phone or another computer sees no questions and never sees the team's reply there.
expected: The owner sees their questions and every reply on any device they sign in on.
who: owners who use the panel on more than one device
how_often: every reply read on another device
fix_line: Keep the owner's questions and replies on the server and load them on any device

evidence: data-count: Crispy Curves crm_records 3 members, 2 payments, 0 voided, 0 expenses, 1 self-join, 0 measurements, 0 challenges: too small for a recount to prove anything
